title: Assert specific reasons in task-sync acceptance refusal tests
outcome: Task-sync refusal tests distinguish the intended refusal from unrelated fixture, revision and missing-context failures.
acceptance: The reported acceptance, movement, concurrency, closure and consumption fault cases assert their intended typed error or AcceptanceUseRefusal rather than accepting any error.
Each closure fault distinguishes a retained ineligible decision from a hard admission error while preserving meaningful rollback checks.
